results.summary: For an order-two seed and one shared physical coordinate, the existing one-hub grouped compiler either has d<=2 or, after adding one fresh column, its complete (1,2,3) currency collapses exactly to the reciprocal cube root of the resulting disjoint 3x3 minor. It cannot spend the large overlap-one determinant.

The first exact copy symmetrization writes |phi_Q|^2 as a bilinear U^T A V integral with per-coordinate paired source factors G_i. For the overlap-one S,T,h block, the bilinear coefficient is exactly A[S+h,T+h]; four nonshared coordinates become cap-1/2 subdensity slices and G_h remains an unsplit cap-1/2 probability density with partial Fourier L2 budget <=pi.

partner_result.actual_application: At r=1/64 its proved inequality gives ||g||_infinity<=256/|lambda|, hence <=256 on normalized shear-flat branches with |lambda|>=1. This scope is not automatically forced by the s8 terminal.

next_obligation: QFORM-OVERLAP-PAIREDBLOCK-CURVED-RECEIVER-v1: prove a dimension-free small-ball or integrated-Fourier bound for the exact six-variable paired overlap block without conditional normalization, fiber suprema, or disjointification.
